external_relation: nine triples (physical row r, physical column c, DTMF keypad row k)
target_relation: one-shot surface as nine triples (Q, physical column c, minority-row value r)
interpretation: Treating both artifacts as ternary coordinate relations gives a bounded six-way role-permutation family rather than an unconstrained image transform family. Four role permutations cannot even form a total 3x3 function because the keypad-row coordinate is not bijective enough to serve as a target input axis. Of the two valid functions, the direct r,c->k surface has no one-shot hit under the six preregistered q maps. The swapped-axis c,r->k surface is the strict transpose 120/012/112 and has exactly one hit: canonical 112/012/120 under q'=2q+2. This makes the candidate a unique isomorphism inside the smallest coordinate-role family, while still not supplying an authorial cue for choosing that role assignment.
